# Flavor Journal

Flavor Journal is an English-language food blog sharing approachable recipes, meal-prep systems, and practical kitchen guides for busy home cooks. Content covers quick breakfasts, weeknight dinners, comfort classics, healthy bowls, budget cooking, and menu planning.
